##### Project General Facts

Tenora by Damac Properties is a prestigious residential project, renowned for its luxurious amenities, interior architectural design, and high-quality finishing, providing residents with an opulent lifestyle. The project boasts a range of fully furnished studio apartments, as well as one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, each meticulously designed to offer a premium living experience. With high-end finishes, modern fixtures, and attention to detail, the interiors of the apartments contribute to the overall elegance of the development.

Tenora offers a diverse array of amenities, including swimming pools, fitness centers, landscaped gardens, and recreational areas, catering to the needs of its discerning residents. The project's emphasis on luxurious amenities and high-quality finishing creates a unique and desirable living environment, perfect for those seeking a hassle-free move-in experience. The fully furnished apartments, complete with separate living rooms and dining areas, provide ample space for residents to entertain and relax in style.

The kitchens in Tenora's apartments are equipped with an array of modern appliances, including washers, dryers, ovens, refrigerators, and microwaves, ensuring that residents can efficiently manage their daily chores. The apartments are fully furnished, with thoughtful layouts and high-quality materials, providing a comfortable and stylish living environment. With their spacious contemporary design and attention to detail, the apartments at Tenora are the epitome of refined living, offering residents a truly exceptional lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South, the location of this prestigious project, is a major urban development and master-planned city, designed to be a self-sustaining and integrated city that encompasses various residential, commercial, industrial, and logistics areas. The area is strategically located near the Expo 2020 site, the world's largest aviation hub, and host of first-class facilities, providing direct access to Al Maktoum International Airport, Jebel Ali Port, and Dubai Metro. Dubai South is also connected to three major roads: Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road, Sheikh Zayed Road, and the Emirates Road, ensuring easy access to the city.

Dubai South is a thriving urban development, with several residential communities and neighborhoods that offer a range of housing options, from apartments to villas, designed to provide residents with a modern and comfortable living environment. The area is one of the most ambitious and extensive projects in Dubai and the wider UAE, formerly known as Dubai World Central, and is poised to become a hub of activity and growth. With its unique blend of residential, commercial, and industrial areas, Dubai South is an exciting and dynamic location, full of opportunities and possibilities.

The location of Dubai South provides residents with a multitude of benefits, including easy access to major transportation hubs, world-class amenities, and a range of entertainment and leisure options. The area is also home to several major landmarks and attractions, including the Expo 2020 site, making it an ideal location for those who want to be at the heart of the action. With its modern infrastructure and high-quality facilities, Dubai South is an attractive location for residents, investors, and businesses alike, offering a unique and exciting lifestyle.
